## How it was tested
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (lint, types, backend tests, end-to-end tests)
- [ ] Added or updated a test that fails without this change
- [ ] Checked it in a browser (desktop and a phone-width screen) if the UI changed

## Risk
- [ ] No schema/content change, **or** `shared/default-content.json`, the backend schema and the frontend types are all updated
- [ ] No new secret, env var or port — **or** `deploy/.env.example` and the docs are updated
